lines.zh: 沐雨修士慢悠悠地踱步
lines.en: Lumen paces slowly, unhurried.

lines.zh: 长袍的下摆扫过草地
lines.en: The robe's hem sweeps the grass.

lines.zh: 他踩过水洼也不绕开
lines.en: He walks straight through puddles.

lines.zh: 雨水顺着他肩头往下流
lines.en: Rain runs off his shoulders.

lines.zh: 他的步伐带着仪式的节奏
lines.en: His steps keep a ritual rhythm.

lines.zh: 他绕过一株枯树继续走
lines.en: He rounds a dead tree and walks on.

lines.zh: 长袍拖过的地方留下水痕
lines.en: A wet trail follows the robe.

lines.zh: 他低头，像在念着什么
lines.en: Head bowed, he seems to be reciting.

lines.zh: 他走得很稳，不看脚下
lines.en: He walks sure-footed without looking down.

lines.zh: 他身上有一层薄薄的水雾
lines.en: A thin mist clings to him.

lines.zh: 他转身时袍角划出一个弧
lines.en: His hem draws an arc as he turns.

lines.zh: 树影在他身上移动
lines.en: Tree shadows slide across him.

lines.zh: 修士静止，双手交叠在身前
lines.en: The monk stands still, hands folded.

lines.zh: 他仰头接住落下的雨水
lines.en: He lifts his face to the falling rain.

lines.zh: 水珠从他下颌滑落
lines.en: Drops slide from his jaw.

lines.zh: 他的长袍无风自动
lines.en: His robe stirs without wind.

lines.zh: 他低声念完一段祷词
lines.en: He finishes a prayer, low.

lines.zh: 他抬手在胸前画了个记号
lines.en: He marks a sign over his chest.

lines.zh: 他站着，像一根旧石柱
lines.en: He stands like an old stone pillar.

lines.zh: 他微微侧头，听远处的水声
lines.en: He tilts his head to distant water.

lines.zh: 雾气在他脚边绕了一圈
lines.en: Mist coils once around his feet.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸慢得近乎停滞
lines.en: His breathing is nearly suspended.

lines.zh: 他把湿透的袖口拧了一下
lines.en: He wrings out a soaked cuff.

lines.zh: 他睁眼时，眼里映着雨
lines.en: When he opens his eyes, rain is in them.

lines.zh: 他抬手拂去肩上的落叶
lines.en: He brushes a leaf from his shoulder.

lines.zh: 他立在那里，像在守什么
lines.en: He stands as if guarding something.

lines.zh: 他轻轻叹了一口气
lines.en: He lets out a quiet breath.

lines.zh: 他看向天边的一线暗色
lines.en: He looks at the dark line on the horizon.

lines.zh: 修士抬眼，视线穿过雨帘
lines.en: The monk lifts his eyes through the rain.

lines.zh: 他把你从头到脚看了一遍
lines.en: He looks you over, head to foot.

lines.zh: 他的目光在你手上停了停
lines.en: His gaze rests a moment on your hands.

lines.zh: 他没有敌意，也没有温度
lines.en: No hostility in him, and no warmth.

lines.zh: 他微微欠身，行了个礼
lines.en: He bows slightly in greeting.

lines.zh: 他把手从袖中抽了出来
lines.en: He draws a hand from his sleeve.

lines.zh: 他似乎在判断你身上有什么
lines.en: He seems to read something on you.

lines.zh: 他的目光扫过你的影子
lines.en: His eyes pass over your shadow.

lines.zh: 他朝你走近一步，很慢
lines.en: He takes one slow step nearer.

lines.zh: 他抬起手，像要触碰
lines.en: He lifts a hand as if to touch.

lines.zh: 然后他收回手，摇了头
lines.en: Then he withdraws it and shakes his head.

lines.zh: 他念了一句，像在为你祈福
lines.en: He murmurs something like a blessing.

lines.zh: 他把你归入“尚可”的一类
lines.en: He sorts you into the acceptable kind.

lines.zh: 他的眼神平静得过了头
lines.en: His calm runs a shade too deep.

lines.zh: 修士晃了一下，扶住身旁的树
lines.en: The monk sways and catches a tree.

lines.zh: 他的袍子上多了一道口
lines.en: A tear opens in his robe.

lines.zh: 他低头看了看伤处，很平静
lines.en: He glances at the wound, calm.

lines.zh: 他退了一步，重新站直
lines.en: He steps back and straightens.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸短了一瞬
lines.en: His breathing catches for a moment.

lines.zh: 他的白光暗了一暗
lines.en: His white light dims.

lines.zh: 他把手按在伤口上，低声祈祷
lines.en: He presses a hand to it and prays low.

lines.zh: 他额上的水珠增多了一层
lines.en: A new sheen of water beads on his brow.

lines.zh: 他没有愤怒，只有注视
lines.en: No anger in him, only attention.

lines.zh: 他慢慢地、无声地调整站姿
lines.en: He shifts his stance slowly and silently.

lines.zh: 修士看了看你递上的东西
lines.en: The monk regards what you offer.

lines.zh: 他没有伸手，只点了点头
lines.en: He does not reach out; he only nods.

lines.zh: 他把手按在那东西上
lines.en: He lays a hand upon it.

lines.zh: 他低声念了一句，才收下
lines.en: He murmurs a phrase before accepting.

lines.zh: 他把东西收进宽大的袖子
lines.en: It vanishes into his broad sleeve.

lines.zh: 他对食物只是略略看了一眼
lines.en: He barely glances at the food.

lines.zh: 他摇头，说这不该给他
lines.en: He shakes his head; this is not for him.

lines.zh: 他接过来，转手放在了地上
lines.en: He takes it and sets it on the ground.

lines.zh: 他把东西还给你，很坚决
lines.en: He returns it to you, firmly.

lines.zh: 他的目光又回到雨里去了
lines.en: His eyes drift back to the rain.

lines.zh: 你撞上修士，他晃了一下
lines.en: You bump the monk and he sways.

lines.zh: 他的袍角带起一阵湿风
lines.en: His hem throws a damp gust.

lines.zh: 他抬手扶稳你，很轻
lines.en: He steadies you with a light hand.

lines.zh: 他退半步，把路让出来
lines.en: He steps back and clears the way.

lines.zh: 他的身体比看上去要沉
lines.en: He is heavier than he looks.

lines.zh: 他低头看了看被碰皱的袖子
lines.en: He frowns at the crease in his sleeve.

lines.zh: 雨水被撞得溅开一圈
lines.en: Rainwater splashes outward.

lines.zh: 他从你身边绕过去
lines.en: He goes around you.

lines.zh: 他的肩头很凉
lines.en: His shoulder feels cold.

lines.zh: 他站定后，重新把手叠好
lines.en: He settles and refolds his hands.

lines.zh: 两位修士并排站着
lines.en: Two monks stand side by side.

lines.zh: 他们同时低头念诵
lines.en: They bow their heads in unison.

lines.zh: 他把一滴雨水抹在对方额上
lines.en: He draws a drop of rain on the other's brow.

lines.zh: 他们交换了一句很轻的话
lines.en: They trade a few quiet words.

lines.zh: 两个人的祷告节奏一致
lines.en: Their prayers keep one rhythm.

lines.zh: 他替同伴拉正了兜帽
lines.en: He straightens his companion's hood.

lines.zh: 他们并肩面向同一个方向
lines.en: They face the same direction together.

lines.zh: 雨水从两人之间流过
lines.en: Rainwater runs down between them.

lines.zh: 他们一人念，一人和
lines.en: One recites, the other answers.

lines.zh: 他们的影子在雨里几乎重合
lines.en: Their shadows nearly merge in the rain.

lines.zh: 修士弯腰拾起东西
lines.en: The monk bends to pick it up.

lines.zh: 他捧着东西，像捧着一件礼器
lines.en: He holds it like a sacred vessel.

lines.zh: 他用袖子把它擦干净
lines.en: He wipes it clean with his sleeve.

lines.zh: 他把东西递给身边的孩子
lines.en: He hands it to a child nearby.

lines.zh: 他把东西放在石台上
lines.en: He sets it on a stone ledge.

lines.zh: 他念了一句，然后收起
lines.en: He recites a line, then puts it away.

lines.zh: 他拾取时动作极慢
lines.en: His movements are very slow.

lines.zh: 他把落下的东西一件件拣起
lines.en: He gathers the fallen items one by one.

lines.zh: 他用两指捏起，很稳
lines.en: Two fingers lift it, steady.

lines.zh: 收好后，他又把手叠回身前
lines.en: Done, his hands fold back in front.

lines.zh: 修士的目光骤然收紧
lines.en: The monk's gaze sharpens abruptly.

lines.zh: 他抬手，掌心泛起白光
lines.en: Light gathers in his raised palm.

lines.zh: 他的袍角向外张开
lines.en: His hem flares outward.

lines.zh: 雨在他周围停了一瞬
lines.en: For an instant the rain hesitates.

lines.zh: 他侧身，把手抬起
lines.en: He turns and raises a hand.

lines.zh: 一声低沉的吟诵传开
lines.en: A low chant rolls outward.

lines.zh: 他把你标记成了要清除的东西
lines.en: He has marked you for removal.

lines.zh: 他踏前一小步，很慢
lines.en: He takes one deliberate step in.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸依旧平稳
lines.en: His breathing barely changes.

lines.zh: 他抬眼看着你，不再悲悯
lines.en: He looks at you without mercy now.

lines.zh: 雾气开始向他聚拢
lines.en: The mist begins gathering to him.

lines.zh: 他低声说了句“站住”
lines.en: He says, low: halt.

lines.zh: 修士缓缓向你走来
lines.en: The monk advances slowly on you.

lines.zh: 他没有加快，也没有停
lines.en: He neither speeds up nor stops.

lines.zh: 他的手一直抬着，掌心发亮
lines.en: His hand stays up, palm alight.

lines.zh: 他绕到你侧面，不慌不忙
lines.en: He works toward your flank, unhurried.

lines.zh: 他踩过水洼，水面纹丝不动
lines.en: He crosses a puddle without a ripple.

lines.zh: 他的视线始终没离开
lines.en: His gaze has not left you.

lines.zh: 他抬手，隔空比了个记号
lines.en: He traces a sign in the air.

lines.zh: 雨点在他身前一寸停住
lines.en: Rain stalls an inch from him.

lines.zh: 他把你的退路都看过了
lines.en: He has mapped your exits.

lines.zh: 他念诵的声音越来越低
lines.en: His chanting drops lower.

lines.zh: 他不急，时间站在他那边
lines.en: No hurry; time is his.

lines.zh: 他每一步都在收紧圈子
lines.en: Each step tightens the circle.

lines.zh: 雾气贴着地面往你这边爬
lines.en: Mist crawls toward you along the ground.

lines.zh: 修士一掌拍出，白光炸开
lines.en: His palm strikes and white light bursts.

lines.zh: 光柱擦着你的肩过去
lines.en: A beam of light shears past your shoulder.

lines.zh: 他从袖中甩出一道水线
lines.en: A line of water lashes from his sleeve.

lines.zh: 他的手按在你的护甲上
lines.en: His hand lands on your armour.

lines.zh: 他抬手一挥，把你推开
lines.en: A sweep of his hand shoves you back.

lines.zh: 他的掌风带着雨水的凉
lines.en: His strike carries the chill of rain.

lines.zh: 一击之后他又退回原位
lines.en: After one strike he returns to his spot.

lines.zh: 他念了一句，光凝成刺
lines.en: He chants and the light hardens to a spike.

lines.zh: 他打得很轻，像在驱赶
lines.en: His blows are light, like shooing.

lines.zh: 水花在他掌心炸开
lines.en: Water bursts in his palm.

lines.zh: 雨里多了一个修长的影子
lines.en: A tall shape joins the rain.

lines.zh: 修士从雾中慢慢显出来
lines.en: The monk resolves out of the mist.

lines.zh: 他的袍角先垂到地面
lines.en: His hem settles to the ground first.

lines.zh: 雾气在他脚下盘了一圈
lines.en: Mist coils once about his feet.

lines.zh: 他站定，双手交叠在身前
lines.en: He stops, hands folded before him.

lines.zh: 雨水在他身边绕开
lines.en: Rain bends around him.

lines.zh: 他抬手把兜帽放了下来
lines.en: He lowers his hood.

lines.zh: 一声低吟从雨幕深处传来
lines.en: A low chant comes from inside the rain.

lines.zh: 他的影子在湿地面上拉长
lines.en: His shadow stretches on the wet ground.

lines.zh: 他缓步走到空地中央
lines.en: He walks slowly to the centre of the clearing.

lines.zh: 他先向四周行了个礼
lines.en: He bows to the four directions first.

lines.zh: 他眼里映着一整片灰白的雨
lines.en: Grey rain fills his eyes.

lines.zh: 他的出现没有惊动一只鸟
lines.en: Not a bird stirs at his arrival.

lines.zh: 他停在离你五十步的地方
lines.en: He halts fifty paces off.

lines.zh: 火焰烧到袍角，他急急扑打
lines.en: Fire catches his hem; he beats it out.

lines.zh: 落地时他单膝触地，随即起身
lines.en: He lands on one knee and rises at once.

lines.zh: 水淹过头顶，他的祷词断了
lines.en: Water closes over him and the prayer breaks.

lines.zh: 冲击撕开他的袍子，人被推出
lines.en: The blast tears his robe and throws him clear.

lines.zh: 箭穿透袖口，划破手臂
lines.en: An arrow passes through his sleeve and cuts his arm.

lines.zh: 异力与他的白光相撞，噼啪作响
lines.en: Alien force meets his light and crackles.

lines.zh: 久未进食，他的动作更加迟缓
lines.en: Long unfed, his movements slow further.

lines.zh: 雷电落下，他浑身焦黑地僵住
lines.en: Lightning strikes; he stiffens, scorched.

lines.zh: 虚空拖住袍角，他向下沉去
lines.en: The void takes his hem and drags him down.
